faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Women and Child Development Department Yadgiri (WCD Yadgiri) in the state of Karnataka for eligible candidates seeking government contractual opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by WCD Yadgiri?
faq.answer: The department has advertised for the position of District Resource Person under this official notification cycle, aiming to fill multiple available vacancies for qualified professionals.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the District Resource Person post. Candidates should review the detailed notification to understand further distribution if applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for WCD Yadgiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 09-10-2026. Interested candidates must ensure their applications reach the designated address on or before this closing date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA in Sociology or MSW along with a minimum of 4 to 5 years of relevant experience in preschool education or the child learning field.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for WCD Yadgiri District Resource Person?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 50 years. Age relaxations may apply as per government norms detailed in the official notification document.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the District Resource Person position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/- per month throughout their contractual employment period.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted via Offline mode. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified postal address.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for candidates belonging to General, OBC, SC, or ST categories. The application fee is listed as Nil for all categories.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for WCD Yadgiri Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an Interview, Qualification Evaluation, Experience Evaluation, and a Computer Test to assess the candidate's suitability for the District Resource Person role.
